Container.Name: BuilderBot
Container.Overview:
Claude Code workstation + self-hosted GitHub Actions runner + Playwright + Android SDK/emulator in one container.
Use it from a terminal: docker exec -it BuilderBot claude Helper CLI inside: docker exec -it BuilderBot bb status
NOTES - The image is a private GHCR package: run `docker login ghcr.io` on the Unraid host once (and persist it via the go file) or the pull will fail. See docs/unraid.md in the repo. - For the Android emulator, add --device=/dev/kvm to Extra Params and set ENABLE_ANDROID_EMULATOR to true. - The Docker socket mapping gives the container control of the host Docker daemon (root-equivalent). Remove that path if you don't want workflow jobs and Claude building images on the host.

Config.Name: MediaReducer project
Config.Description: First project directory, visible to Claude Code at /workspace/mediareducer-dev

Config.Name: FreshBoot project
Config.Description: Second project directory, visible to Claude Code at /workspace/FreshBoot

Config.Name: Home (Claude login, shell config)
Config.Description: Persists Claude Code credentials, npm globals, AVDs and shell history across image updates

Config.Name: Config (custom startup hooks)
Config.Description: Drop your own *.sh files into startup.d/ here to run them at container start

Config.Name: Runner work directory
Config.Description: Where GitHub Actions jobs check out code

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Claude and CI jobs run docker build / docker compose against the Unraid daemon. Root-equivalent on the host - remove if unwanted.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: File-owner uid (99 = Unraid's nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: File-owner gid (100 = Unraid's users)

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: API-key billing. Leave empty to log in with a Claude subscription instead (docker exec -it BuilderBot bb login, one time).

Config.Name: AUTO_UPDATE_CLAUDE
Config.Description: Update Claude Code on every container start

Config.Name: GITHUB_URL
Config.Description: Repo URL (https://github.com/OWNER/REPO) or org URL (https://github.com/ORG) the runner registers with

Config.Name: GITHUB_PAT
Config.Description: Fine-grained PAT with Administration read+write on the target repo (mints runner tokens; also authenticates gh + git + ghcr pushes inside)

Config.Name: ENABLE_RUNNER
Config.Description: Set false to run as a pure Claude workstation

Config.Name: RUNNER_NAME
Config.Description: Runner name shown in GitHub

Config.Name: RUNNER_LABELS
Config.Description: Labels workflows target with runs-on

Config.Name: RUNNER_EPHEMERAL
Config.Description: Fresh registration per job (recommended)

Config.Name: GIT_USER_NAME
Config.Description: git commit author name

Config.Name: GIT_USER_EMAIL
Config.Description: git commit author email

Config.Name: ENABLE_ANDROID_EMULATOR
Config.Description: Create the default AVD at startup. Also add --device=/dev/kvm to Extra Params. Start with: bb emu start

Config.Name: NPM_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: auth token for npm publish to registry.npmjs.org

Config.Name: EXTRA_APT_PACKAGES
Config.Description: Space-separated apt packages installed at every start

Config.Name: EXTRA_NPM_PACKAGES
Config.Description: Space-separated global npm packages installed at every start

Config.Name: EXTRA_PIPX_PACKAGES
Config.Description: Space-separated pipx tools installed at every start

Config.Name: PROJECT_BOOTSTRAP
Config.Description: Run each project's .builderbot/setup.sh at start

Config.Name: CHOWN_PROJECTS
Config.Description: Recursively chown project mounts to PUID:PGID at start
